plugins.name: live-voice
plugins.description: Talk with Claude out loud: it reads Claude's answers in a natural local voice, and you can talk over it to pause, ask a question or give a command

plugins.name: chime
plugins.description: A soft sound when Claude finishes a longer reply, and a different one when Claude needs your answer or OK

plugins.name: usage-card
plugins.description: A card above the prompt in every chat with your context, usage limits and their resets, session time and cost, plus a short pill in the bottom bar

plugins.name: subagents
plugins.description: A side pane with one colorful live card per subagent: its task, model, the step it's on, a progress bar, tool calls, tokens and time

plugins.name: mod-manager
plugins.description: A Mods pane with a colorful card for every installed mod: what it does, how to use it, and an on/off switch

plugins.name: break-reminder
plugins.description: A ☕ countdown to your next break in the bottom bar, then a "Take a break" toast, a soft sound and drifting bubbles every 15 minutes of work
